Title: Help with a deck concept: Samedi Transfusion

Messages.Author: Count Orlok
Messages.Body:
So for some time I've wanted to build a deck using the Samedi combat card "Transfusion"

Transfusion

Only usable after a successful action. Add 1 blood to a ready vampire.
As  above, but add 1 life to a ghoul or 1 blood to a ready vampire.
Only usable after combat if this vampire is still ready and successfully inflicted any damage on the opposing minion in that combat. Put a transfusion counter on the opposing minion. If the minion now has 3 of your transfusion counters, burn them all to take control of that minion. Only one Transfusion may be played at superior each turn.

Any suggestions on how to get this to work? I was thinking of using Troglodytia and her compatriots with many rushes and a lot of damage prevention. I'm not looking for a tournament winning deck here, but one that is playable in a casual environment. Suggestions on how to get this to work?

Baron of Berkeley

Messages.Body:

> I'm looking for a tournament winning deck here, but one that is playable in a casual environment.

I'm going to assume that you meant not a tournament winning deck.

> Suggestions on how to get this to work?
>
This is going to sound negative but I feel that it needs to be said: there's no way to make superior Transfusion work in the sense that you wouldn't be better off with a 90x Ascendance-deck.

In the best case scenario, you'll need a rush action, stealth, Transfusion and a turn to achieve one third of your goal. That's assuming no kind of combat defense at all. If you include countermeasures against combat defense and other interference the card chain gets completely out of hand.

Let's say the trick works out and you steal someone. What do you do with him? Rush and punch for 1? Bleed for 1 at stealth? Clog up the deck with useful actions? It's just one of those cards that looks like fun but has absolutely everything going against it. This is coming from the guy who regularly starts deck lists with Agent of Power and Clan Impersonation.

Messages.Author: Azel
Messages.Body:
You're looking for a fun deck at best. And I'm with you, it is a very tempting card; I just wish I had more copies to futz around with. I will say the 'outferior' is the best ability, especially with the Path of Bone existing. If you wanted to do a stronger deck based on that, that'd be easy.

Given that you wanna minion steal -- and not dissuaded that the brokenness of dominate continues to have the strongest version of permanent minion steal since the original Jyhad set, Graverobbing -- there's a few directions I'd take this. Fastest result would be 2 of your turns (at least 2 table rounds) due to "Only one Transfusion may be played at superior each turn." clause:

1) Dirty Contract (or whatever) for rush, DIvine Sign for blocks. Req: THN nec (7 vampires)

2) Hidden Lurker, Divine Sign for blocks. THN nec obf (7 vampires)

3) Hidden Lurker and Fast Reaction (better chance to land the strike). THN aus obf (4 vampires)

4) Dirty Contract (or whatever) for rush and Status Perfectus. Req: THN (12 vampires)

And all of these methods are very conditional...

The big thing is you need to be able to get into combat as the reacting minion because this speeds up the combo. You need to use other people's turns to beat that ending clause.

Messages.Body: A requirement for playing action modifiers is that you have to be the acting minion. As usual, the Golden Rule of Cardtext ( Rulebook 1.4 ) might override this rule in some cases, such as Hidden Lurker.

Messages.Author: Azel
Messages.Body:
Exactly. Hidden Lurker has explicit text allowing the exception. Transfusion does not. Therefore, since Transfusion is an Act Mod only, with no text allowing exceptions, it has to be played only by the acting minion.

Ghoul allies/retainers are fair targets. Though outside of keeping Gregory Winter alive w/o exposure, or Bima hordes, I'm at a bit of a loss. And there's always mortal ally + Ghouled, which might be interesting in a Brujah + Samedi mix. Putrescent Servitude also could help. But again, not many allies are worth their costs, let alone the extra card slots.

It does pique my madness for something to do with Rafastio Ghouls. Rafastio Ghouls, Biothaumaturgic Experiment, Elephant Guardians, Apportation press to continue. Transfusions to keep the insanity alive. But by then, am I really playing to win anymore?
